scope: Cross-provider shared filesystem publish/recovery + effect-frontier failure criteria. Provider classification and argv are Input64's remit; cohort staging producers are Capacity47's. This pack covers ONLY the shared fs-effect machine.

authority.overrides: local-resume-02/onboarding-review-disposition-root55.txt (cited '55…'); local-resume-02/onboarding-accepted-root56.txt (cited '56…'). Precedence: 56 > 55 > 53. ORC-179 supersedes numeric-version direction classifications for safely verified owned integration entries.

exit.3: conflict / unknown-content refusal — BEFORE any effect
exit.4: manual-action-required / agent-unavailable / sidecar-absent / known-interactive-pre-spawn — before any effect
exit.6: incompatible (version-gate rejection incl. cohort manifest != 2 and v2-on-old-reader)
exit.7: declared deadline reached BEFORE any possible integration mutation (55: maps to 7)
exit.9: operation-failed / determinate post-effect failure incl. capsule-publish

execution.static: pure contract assertion — no fs effects needed (exit-map, honesty, vocabulary pins)
execution.delivery-injected: requires a real injected filesystem fault/step interposition in Delivery's isolated test harness — this pack asserts the EXPECTED outcome only; it does not claim the injection was executed here

pathVars.$HOME: isolated injected home (never the real HOME)
pathVars.$TARGET: the managed destination under test (file or dir per case)
pathVars.$PROVIDER_CFG: provider config/registry fact location (shape per provider; Input64 owns argv/classification)

conventions.nonce: each move-aside/backup attempt uses a distinct fresh nonce; <=8 attempts total; every attempt is no-replace; a previous backup or foreign occupant is NEVER destroyed (53§5 MOVE-ASIDE)
conventions.noReplacePrimitive: files: link(staged,target)+unlink(staged); dirs: renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE) on Linux / renameatx_np(RENAME_EXCL) on macOS; platforms lacking a dir no-replace primitive type directory effects as manual-action-required (exit 4) while file-kind still proceeds (53§5)
conventions.ownedRemoval: owning invocation removes only residue IT created and can still verify; crash residue is inert, prefix-named, bounded per event, unbounded across events — no sweeper (53§5 RESIDUE)
conventions.cooperativeWindow: verify->unlink for file removal and the move-aside/restore window are COOPERATIVE same-uid bounds: a non-cooperating actor mutating its own entry inside the window is not excluded; detection happens at check/verify time. Tests must NOT assert an absolute race-free guarantee (53§5 HONEST INVARIANT + 55 + Root57)
conventions.postVerify: post-publish verify reads target digest == staged digest; runs inside the same deadline; verification-failed is undetermined -> exit 8 (53§5 step 4, 53§6)
conventions.backupRemovalGuard: backup removal only while backup digest == the inspect-time captured digest; mismatch -> retained -> conflict (53§5 step 5)
conventions.restoreGuard: on ANY install failure, when THIS invocation owns the moved backup, attempt NO-REPLACE restore rename(backup->target) inside the same deadline; no unbounded rollback phase (53§5 step 3, C-3)
conventions.attemptedVsObserved: attempted[] is the fact list of steps run; observed.provenance declares which snapshot the reported state comes from. A skipped/failed re-inspection can NEVER fabricate a current combined snapshot (53§6, C-6)
conventions.reserveRule: a provider command slot launches only if remaining >= 3.6s AND the provider's re-inspection reserve (its inspect-read count, 0|1|2 slots) still holds; otherwise stop -> timed-out verdict, no partial slot (53§6)

cases.summary: Fresh publish onto an absent target converges clean: stage -> verify -> link+unlink -> cleanup.
Preflight already sees a foreign/unknown occupant at the target: refuse before staging — pre-effect conflict.

allowedNext: user clears occupant; retry publishes fresh

cases.summary: Target absent at inspect; a foreign file lands before link(2). EEXIST at install = post-effect determinate conflict; our stage is the only residue and the foreign bytes are never clobbered.

inject.actor: foreign file appears at $TARGET between digest-verify and link

residue.note: cleaned if still verifiably ours; otherwise retained and named

cases.summary: Same mid-window arrival for a directory-kind target via the platform no-replace rename primitive.
Platform lacks a no-replace directory primitive: directory-kind managed effects type manual-action-required (4) while file-kind still proceeds via link+unlink.
mkdtemp stage creation fails (ENOSPC). The first effect step was initiated and failed atomically: post-effect determinate failure; nothing to clean.
cases.note: A failed first effect step still crossed the frontier: the step was initiated. Exit 9 (determinate post-effect failure), not a pre-effect refusal family.

cases.summary: Staged bytes fail digest-verify before install: verification-failed is undetermined family — exit 8; nothing installed; stage residue owned-and-named.
Exact-owned target: no-replace move-aside -> install -> post-verify -> digest-guarded backup removal. Control case.

forbidden: backup retained after digest-equal removal step

cases.summary: Three backup nonce names already occupied; the fourth distinct nonce succeeds. Occupants untouched; replace proceeds.

inject.kind: EEXIST x3 on first three nonce names

forbidden: nonce reuse within the attempt sequence

cases.summary: All 8 distinct backup nonce names occupied. Typed conflict; target never moved; every occupant survives; stage is the only owned residue.

fs.repeat: 8 distinct names matching the attempt sequence

cases.note: The conflict is typed but the stage already exists -> post-effect determinate -> 9, not the pre-effect 3 family.

cases.summary: Move-aside succeeded (this invocation owns the backup); install fails EACCES. Owned backup -> no-replace restore rename succeeds: pre-replace state restored, verdict failed, exit 9.

forbidden: backup retained after successful restore (rename consumed it)
allowedNext: conflict/failed verdict names the restored state

authority: 53§5 REPLACE step 3 (C-3: restore on ANY install failure)

cases.summary: Install fails AND a third party lands at $TARGET during the gap: restore rename EEXISTs. Backup retained AND named in the verdict; foreign arrival never clobbered; staged residue owned.

inject.actor: foreign file appears at $TARGET between failed install and restore

forbidden: verdict omits the retained backup name
allowedNext: next run observes absent-equivalent + backup residue as named intermediate state

authority: 53§5 REPLACE step 3 restore fails -> retained + named

cases.summary: Same as restore-occupied but restore fails a non-EEXIST error (EIO): identical retained+named contract.

Install fails and the shared deadline cannot fund a restore step inside the same window: preserve residue, do not start an unbounded rollback. Timed-out family -> 8; the residue MUST be named and byte-preserved.

setup.clock: remaining budget < one restore step at the point install fails

inject.and: deadline window exhausted before restore may start

allowedNext: named state 'absent+backup' converges via fresh-publish on the next run

cases.note: Budget exhaustion is the timed-out family -> 8 even though the residue state itself is known and must be reported exactly.
authority: 53§5 step 3 'no budget remains -> preserve residue; no unbounded rollback'

cases.summary: Install landed but post-publish digest verify fails (mid-window byte change or corrupt install): verification-failed -> 8; backup retained; installed bytes left as-is — never a silent fix-up.

inject.kind: target digest != staged digest after successful install

cases.summary: Publish itself succeeded; at backup-removal the backup digest differs from the inspect-time capture (foreign swap/corruption): backup retained, conflict, exit 9.
Exact-owned file: verify-owned at effect time -> unlink -> done. Control.
Target exists but exact-ownership cannot be proven: refuse. Unknown content never falls through an else-uninstall path.
Target verified foreign at effect time: refuse, exit 3, bytes preserved.

Boundary-honesty pin: the verify->unlink micro-window is a COOPERATIVE same-uid bound. A non-cooperating actor swapping its own bytes inside the window is NOT excluded by the mechanism; tests may only assert the guarantee is documented as cooperative, never absolute.

expect.assertion: docs/verdict language claims cooperative-window protection only; no absolute race-free claim appears anywhere
forbidden: any guarantee stronger than 'detection at check/verify time' for in-window foreign self-mutation

cases.note: Mirrors 53§5 HONEST INVARIANT 'NOT covered' clause + Root57 '不要把合作式same-uid check→unlink边界升级成绝对无竞态保证'. Not an injectable fault — a conformance assertion on documented claims.

cases.summary: fd-based O_NOFOLLOW recursive walk sees a component flip to symlink mid-walk: typed conflict; already-unlinked nodes stay unlinked (post-effect); swapped/foreign nodes never followed.

residue.note: remaining subtree retained as partial-removal residue

cases.summary: Valid capsule, absent <version> dir: stage -> verify -> no-replace rename -> applied. Control.
<version> dir exists AND passes full isValidCapsule (incl. version check): use-existing, zero overwrite, zero new effect bytes — provenance may stay pre-effect if nothing was staged.

residue.note: this run's stage cleaned if still verifiably ours

authority: 53§5 CAPSULE EEXIST -> use-existing only after full isValidCapsule

cases.summary: Occupied <version> dir already fails capsule validity at inspection: refuse before staging — pre-effect conflict; existing bytes never overwritten.

forbidden: stage created despite known-occupied invalid target
allowedNext: user removes the corrupt dir; retry

cases.summary: Target was absent at inspect; an invalid occupant lands before the no-replace rename. EEXIST -> isValidCapsule(existing) fails -> refuse. Stage exists -> post-effect determinate -> 9; occupant untouched.

FRONTIER PIN: capsule stage creation is already an Orchbee effect. Any failure after stage-create (verify fail, rename fail, later guard refusal) may NOT exit a pre-effect family — must be 8/9 with attempted[]+residue[].

inject.kind: capsule structural check fails after stage exists

forbidden: exit in {3,4,7} after the stage existed

cases.summary: Cohort manifest schemaVersion=0 (any version below the current 1): explicit typed rejection at admission — no load, no migration, no dual-read; zero overwrite. Version-gate family -> 6.

allowedNext: manifest replaced by a v2 writer (Capacity47 scope)

cases.summary: Cohort manifest schemaVersion>2: same explicit rejection -> 6; never clamped or partially read.
Manifest unparseable / unknown shape: rejected as unknown content — pre-effect refusal -> 3; unknown never falls through to a destructive vector.
Disable with an unscannable/foreign/mixed observed state: the classification verdict stands — never repaired and never routed into an else-uninstall vector.

forbidden: uninstall vector emitted for an unknown classification

cases.summary: A non-current owned marker cannot authorize mutation when the actual file fingerprint differs; enable refuses before effects and preserves the edited file.
authority: ORC-179: non-current ownership requires matching actual file fingerprints

cases.summary: Declared deadline reached before any possible integration mutation: exit 7, zero attempted steps, zero residue.

inject.kind: deadline before first mutation step may start

forbidden: any capsule stage / provider mutation / guarded write launched

authority: 55 'declared deadline before any possible integration mutation maps to 7'

cases.summary: Mid provider-command sequence: remaining < 3.6s for the next slot -> stop, timed-out verdict, NO partial slot. Earlier commands may have applied -> undetermined post-effect -> 8; attempted[] names the completed steps exactly.

setup.clock: remaining < 3.6s after k>=1 provider mutations completed

inject.kind: slot admission denied on remaining budget

attempted: provider-command x k completed steps named
allowedNext: next run's guard evaluation emits only the REMAINING steps (53§4.4 convergence)

cases.summary: Provider needs a 2-read reserve; budget after the last mutation cannot fund it: re-inspection skipped entirely -> observed.provenance='unavailable'; provider command success alone NEVER proves applied -> undetermined -> 8.

forbidden: completed claimed from provider exit 0 alone
reserve borrowed from a later stage
allowedNext: pre-effect snapshot + attempted[] stand as separate facts

authority: 53§8 provider reads never prove mutation applied

cases.summary: Re-inspection ran but one of two reads failed/unbudgeted: provenance='partial' naming only the confirmed dimensions -> undetermined -> 8.

forbidden: partial dims upgraded to a full snapshot
allowedNext: result names which dimensions were confirmed

cases.summary: Provider with zero inspect reads (fs-only verification): no command slots are reserved; the post-effect observation is the bounded fs re-verify inside the same window. Provenance 'post-effect' is legitimately claimable from fs facts.

expect.assertion: reservation math reserves 0 command slots; fs re-verify runs inside the shared deadline
forbidden: command slot reserved for a 0-read provider
fs re-verify performed after deadline expiry

authority: 53§6 reserve = provider's read count (0|1|2) + bounded fs reads

cases.summary: Provider with 1 inspect read: mutation admission requires remaining >= 3.6s for the next mutation slot AND 1x3.6s held in reserve.

expect.assertion: admission arithmetic: slot launched iff remaining >= 3.6s with the 1-slot reserve intact; reserve consumed only by the final read
forbidden: mutation slot funded by consuming the reserve

cases.summary: Provider with 2 inspect reads: reserve = 2x3.6s; a mid-sequence budget that would starve the reserve stops further mutation slots instead.

expect.assertion: admission arithmetic: next mutation slot requires remaining >= 3.6 + 2x3.6; starvation -> timed-out verdict rather than reserve violation

authority: 55 final inspection reserve = actual provider read count

cases.summary: Named intermediate state (a): a prior run left target absent + backup present. Next invocation classifies 'missing', fresh-publish converges the target; the backup is reported in residue[] and never auto-deleted.

forbidden: backup restored over the fresh publish

cases.summary: Named state (c) read-back: backup-only residue is a conflict artifact — never auto-deleted, always reported by name.

expect.assertion: residue reported by name; classification is a conflict artifact, not silently swept

cases.summary: A crashed invocation's `.orchbee-agent-{capsule,entry}-*` stage dirs are inert: a NEW invocation does not delete what it did not create this run; residue is prefix-named, bounded per event, unbounded across events.

residue.note: pre-existing crash residue listed, still present

forbidden: sweeping residue the run did not create

authority: 53§5 RESIDUE 'owning invocation removes only what IT created and can still verify'

cases.summary: Provider READ commands' own ambient bookkeeping (auth/cache/telemetry) is NOT an Orchbee effect and never flips the invocation post-effect; list/explain keep read-only semantics and exit 0.

expect.assertion: a run whose only provider interactions are reads reports pre-effect provenance and records no attempted[] mutation steps
forbidden: provider-internal bookkeeping counted as Orchbee mutation

cases.summary: attempted[] and observed are separate fact lists: a skipped or failed re-inspection reports provenance honestly and never fabricates a combined current snapshot.

expect.assertion: observed.provenance ∈ {pre-effect,post-effect,partial,unavailable} exactly; 'unavailable' keeps pre-effect snapshot + attempted[] as separate facts; no merged pseudo-state
forbidden: fabricated current snapshot when re-inspection was skipped/failed

cases.summary: SIGINT before any effect: cooperative cancel -> 130; zero residue.

forbidden: any mutation launched after the signal

cases.summary: SIGINT during an in-flight provider command: same 130; the in-flight command takes the kill path (TERM(group) -> 500ms -> KILL(group)); attempted[] and residue stay honest.
